field.name: Viña en Cuíña, Vilanova de Arousa (O Salnés)

observations: Parcel boundary from OpenStreetMap (way 1318910132): landuse=vineyard, crop=grape; variety albariño assumed for demo (not verified in OSM)
Location: Cuíña, Tremoedo, Vilanova de Arousa, comarca O Salnés (Pontevedra), inside the Rías Baixas denomination
Every soil, weather, NDVI and scouting value below is synthetic demo data, not verified for this polygon
Rain-fed vineyard with no irrigation system installed, so water management is limited to drainage and canopy work
Trained on traditional overhead pergola at roughly 90% canopy cover, which leaves the inner rows poorly ventilated
Soil moisture read at 30 cm over granitic subsoil; effective rooting depth close to 60 cm and the profile has sat at or above field capacity for five days
36 mm of Atlantic rainfall spread over the last five days, with leaf wetness persisting until mid-morning
Downy mildew lesions on about 5% of leaves in the two lowest-ventilation rows; last copper application 11 days ago
Berry sampling three days ago gave 19.5 °Brix, so harvest is expected within 10 to 14 days
No wilting or midday leaf folding anywhere in the plot
